note: Scripture came from the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, irvhin) — the text `language_seed.py` records for this language — fetched whole from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx, which serves USX). All 66 books, 31,104 verses on disk, so translators could look up anything that sounded like scripture.

A `mined` row means an exact byte substring of the IRV of at least 30 characters, measured against the finished file — not a translator's claim. The 30-char threshold (vs the sermon runs' 45) is calibrated to biographies, which quote short clauses; it is conservative and UNDERCOUNTS very short verbatim quotations toward self_rendered, adding review rather than manufacturing a clean bill of health.

A biography quotes its SUBJECT far more than it quotes the Bible. Pull-quotes of the person's own words are reported speech and are deliberately NOT recorded as scripture references; several bios in this batch quote little or no scripture, which is the honest answer rather than a gap.
